Water Main Break Closes Section of US 27 Posted: Updated: 
BOURBON COUNTY, Ky. (LEX 18)-- A major road in Paris will be closed for hours Friday morning after a water main break. 
It happened around 6:30 a.m. on Lexington Road (US 27) at Reinhold Street. 
The city of Paris says no one has lost service and they don’t anticipate anyone will. Right now they are clearing the road of ice. Once cleared to do so they will dig to determine how extensive the repairs will be. 
Two lanes will be blocked for around three hours. 
There is a detour established from Lexington Road on to Reinhold Street to Matlack to Bethlehem Road.
